cases.sentence: Царь Ровоам послал Адонирама , надсмотрщика за ___, но израильтяне забили его камнями до смерти.
cases.explain: «подневольными рабочими» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

cases.translation: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

cases.explain: «золотых тельцов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”

cases.sentence: Он установил праздник на пятнадцатый день ___, как тот, что справляли в Иудее , и приносил жертвы на жертвеннике в Вефиле — жертвы тельцам, которых он сделал.

cases.translation: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

cases.sentence: На пятнадцатый день ___, который он выбрал самовольно, установив праздник для израильтян, он подошел к жертвеннику, построенному им в Вефиле, чтобы возжечь благовония.
cases.explain: «восьмого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar, to burn incense.
